pack_routes.experiment: Write primitive motion and gearing observations.
Destructively strain shafts and gears under rotation.
Cycle a precision mechanism under a measured lubricated load.
Load-test a supervised motor and precision drive train.
Prepare primitive copper coupons and record their condition.
Flatten a bronze coupon to expose forming defects.
Section an aluminum qualification plate under coolant.
Characterize a superconductor plate through a cryogenic cut.
Bottle and annotate a primitive thermal-process sample.
Run a controlled heated flux and carbon process.
Sample a controlled naphtha-to-polymer qualification batch.
Qualify high-purity titanium chemistry with acid handling.
Write manifests for a primitive storage and hand-transport route.
Deploy a track coupon onto a written service manifest.
Record a repeatable heavy-locomotive freight cycle.
Correlate AE2 demand and supervised freight throughput.
Catalog surface ore pieces and primitive field observations.
Crush a field ore sample and record its mineral response.
Correlate a reusable quarry instrument with a deep ore sample.
Model planetary extraction against a reusable Digital Miner.
Record a repeatable botanical observation by hand.
Mix controlled belladonna, mandrake, and mineral samples.
Observe a reusable attuned stone under repeatable electrical control.
Correlate a controlled altar, Starcore, and advanced computation.
Record passive inductor measurements before the first powered assembler. Keep the clamp meter; consume an inductor and two sheets of paper.
Record breaker, gauge, and computer response under load.
Load-test high-voltage protection and superconducting conductors.
Compute and print a validated analog model.
Run a networked simulation on a reusable computer.
Execute a quantum model under advanced computer supervision.
Run a reusable motor against a measured naphtha impulse.
Hot-fire a reusable first-generation rocket engine.
Fire a reusable heavy thruster under cryogenic supervision.
Assay a uranium sample with a reusable dosimeter.
Perform a destructive fuel assay under reusable computer and dosimeter control.
Characterize deuterium and tritium against a reusable fusion controller.
Study a Starcore non-destructively under advanced computation.
Measure Strange Matter production against a reusable accelerator controller.
Record projectile flight, impact and defensive positioning without consuming a weapon.
Measure a reusable copper javelin against standardized target media.
Consume a standardized solid shot while retaining the cannon builder as a test fixture.
Correlate a consumed test projectile with reusable ballistic and fire-control instruments.
Characterize a plutonium core and compression charge under retained radiological and digital instrumentation.
Combine a recovered inert glyph fragment with lunar geology and a navigational reference.
Compare the Martian hieroglyph sequence against the Lunar artifact dossier.
Instrument a recovered field symbol and compare it with Venusian pressure and thermal data.
Resolve the relay cartouche against a calibrated compass and stellar-computation model.
Decode the recovered Tollan memory crystal with quantum computation and an established Milky Way gate model.
